ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has allotted 186,440 new equity shares on September 17, 2026, as a result of employees exercising their stock options under the company's 2020 ESOP plan. This routine corporate action increases the paid-up equity share capital to Rs. 4,38,39,31,570, resulting in a minor dilution for existing shareholders, and presents no immediate red flags.
